work.title: Portable Semantics, Private Dialects: Reuse and Negative Transfer in Latent Communication Between Language-Model Cells
work.notes: Companion audit of six learned interfaces and all 30 ordered transfer pairs under a frozen alignment ladder; authors report cross-initialization failures and interface-level negative transfer. Conclusions are limited to a 17-state near-transfer task and shared-backbone model cells, not arbitrary independently pretrained models. Author artifacts: https://github.com/tokenosopher/populus-evidence-partitioning. Same-author studies are not independent replications. No checkpoint execution or universal shared-language conclusion.

work.title: What You Can't See Is What You Learn: Restricted Evidence Visibility Favors Compositional Generalization in Shared-Genome Language-Model Societies
work.venue: arXiv preprint; title variant reviewed from author artifact
work.notes: Title follows the reviewed primary indexed record and author README. A later Slot-Selective Evidence Masking title variant was found on secondary mirrors; latest version-specific primary verification remains pending. Four cells share a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct backbone and learned adapters/continuous packets. Author release records a formal preregistered floor failure despite large relative gains; do not promote it as a full preregistered pass. Evidence masks may change both visibility and usable role information. Author source: https://github.com/tokenosopher/populus-evidence-partitioning. No general causal-visibility claim or independent replication.

work.title: What You Can't See Is Still What You Learn: A Preregistered Sixty-Society Confirmation That Evidence Masking Drives Compositional Generalization
work.notes: Same-author confirmation with sixty shared-backbone four-cell systems, varying masking, markers and filler. Authors report a preregistered behavioral pass, but usable-role attribution remains unresolved because globally visible systems failed the marker-following check. Finite success-conditioned packet interventions do not establish causal mediation. Narrow task-family confirmation, not independent replication or a guarantee for heterogeneous C2C.
